new_entities.name: Oral contraceptive used with a broad-spectrum antibiotic
aliases: combined oral contraceptive plus broad-spectrum antibiotic
new_entities.description: Use of a combined oral contraceptive during treatment with a broad-spectrum antibiotic that is not a rifamycin.

new_entities.name: Contraceptive failure
new_entities.description: Failure of a contraceptive method resulting in unintended conception.

edges.effect_quant: Large case-crossover data did not show a clear overall increase in breakthrough pregnancy with antibiotics overall (case-time-control OR 1.12, 95% CI 0.63-1.98), while a Dutch prescription-database study found an apparent association that disappeared for broad-spectrum antibiotics in sensitivity analysis.
edges.population: reproductive-age women using combined oral contraceptives who receive non-rifamycin broad-spectrum antibiotics
edges.mechanism: The hypothesized interaction is reduced enterohepatic recirculation of contraceptive steroids after antibiotic-induced alteration of gut flora, but this mechanism has not produced a consistent clinical failure signal outside of rifamycin-class enzyme induction.
edges.summary: This is a genuinely contested edge rather than a settled interaction. Modern observational evidence does not show a robust, reproducible broad-spectrum-antibiotic signal, but the literature is noisy enough that historical caution persists in some guidance and patient counseling.
edges.caveats: This edge does not apply to rifampin or similar enzyme inducers, which are much stronger and more clinically important interactions. Breakthrough-pregnancy studies are vulnerable to adherence bias, recall bias, and confounding by illness or gastrointestinal upset.

evidence.notes: Antibiotics and oral contraceptive failure - a case-crossover study.

effect_quant.comparator: case-time-control estimate for antibiotics overall and breakthrough pregnancy among combined oral contraceptive users

evidence.citation: Helms SE et al 1997 Biopharm Drug Dispos
evidence.notes: Are antibiotics related to oral combination contraceptive failures in the Netherlands? A case-crossover study.

effect_quant.comparator: age-adjusted case-control estimate for antibiotic exposure in the breakthrough-pregnancy exposure window versus controls
